data.subject: Earn More on Every Rupee You Save – Introducing XDeposit
data.body:
Dear Valued Customer,

We are delighted to introduce XDeposit – SuperBFSI's flagship term deposit product designed to help you earn significantly more on your savings.

Why XDeposit?
  • 1% higher annual returns than standard fixed deposits
  • Additional 0.25% benefit exclusively for senior women customers
  • No market risk – your principal is fully protected
  • Flexible tenures from 6 months to 5 years
  • 100% digital – no branch visits, no paperwork

Your savings represent years of hard work. Let them grow faster, safer, and smarter.

Explore XDeposit and lock in your returns today:
https://superbfsi.com/xdeposit/explore/

We look forward to helping you achieve your financial goals.

Warm regards,
SuperBFSI Investment Team
